def transform(grid):
    # Overlay the aligned mask layers onto background cells of the top pattern.
    out = [row[:] for row in grid[:3]]
    for r in range(3):
        for c in range(6):
            if out[r][c] == 0:
                if grid[r + 3][c] == 4:
                    out[r][c] = 4
                elif grid[r + 9][c] == 8:
                    out[r][c] = 8
                elif grid[r + 6][c] == 2:
                    out[r][c] = 2
    return out
PY
